playbook.name: Disk almost full notice
playbook.description: When the disk that holds the evidence has less than a tenth free, a message says how much is left; Nik says it once a day while it stays so. To send it: add an instance of the Mail connector with an SMTP server (Settings, Connectors), put your address in the node "Send the notice" and list its domain among the hosts this playbook may reach.

args.subject: Nik: {{ trigger.disk.free_percent | default('little') }}% of the evidence disk is free
args.text:
The disk that holds Nik's evidence is nearly full: {{ trigger.disk.free | default(0) }} bytes free of {{ trigger.disk.total | default(0) }} ({{ trigger.disk.free_percent | default('?') }}%).

Settings, Storage shows what fills it: samples, captures, mailboxes, backups. Uploads fail when it is full.
